_comment: HyperPod instance types eligible for EFA-only network interface (NetworkInterface.InterfaceType=efa-only). Criterion: EFA-supported AND multi-EFA-card (NetworkInfo.EfaInfo.MaximumEfaInterfaces > 1). efa-only cannot be the primary NIC, so single-EFA-card types are intentionally excluded. Source: aws ec2 describe-instance-types (network-info.efa-supported / MaximumNetworkCards / EfaInfo.MaximumEfaInterfaces), 2026-06, intersected with instance-type-options.json. p6-b200/b300 added per EC2 EFA docs (not enumerable in us-east-1/us-west-2). trn1/trn1n/trn2 are eligible but not in instance-type-options.json yet.
